gh pr create --title "Fix login loop when the session cookie expires" --body "## Problem
When the session cookie expired, the page froze: \`refresh()\` in \`src/auth.js\` recursed into itself forever (\`if (session.expired) return refresh(session)\`).

## Fix
- \`refresh()\` now awaits a new \`fetchSession()\` call when the session is expired, and returns the session unchanged otherwise.
- Added \`fetchSession()\`: fetches a new session from \`/api/session\` and throws on a non-OK response.

Verified both paths (valid session passthrough, expired session refetch) with a quick node check.

Fixes #7"
